items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: That's where Piro and bands like Sam Morgan, had what we call soft pedal bands.

ctx.x: Would it be like the younger clarinet player?

No, it wasn't. Smooth or rough? No, it was rough. Oh, good Dixieland is rough. Right. Dixieland is not smooth. That's what plenty of people don't understand. Dixieland is rough. It's not. That's where Piro and bands like Sam Morgan, had what we call soft pedal bands. They would play such smooth and nice. Well that wasn't considered as Dixieland. They were stock bands. They played stock music. But Dixieland was played from the heart, soul and mind. That's what made it so good. But it was rough.
Sam wasn't rough then. His band was smooth. Real smooth. When was that? That was the old Sam Morgan band before?
